name: UWA Guild Grant
summary: Grant of up to $400 for UWA Guild members in severe financial difficulty who cannot repay a Guild loan.
key: We offer Guild grants up to $400 to students who are experiencing severe financial difficulties.
who: Currently enrolled at UWA and a current Guild member
Severe financial hardship, other options exhausted, and unable to repay a Guild loan
how: Download and complete the Guild grant form
catches: Does not cover course fees, social or holiday costs, or ongoing rent, groceries or bills

evidence.quote: We offer Guild grants up to $400 to students who are experiencing severe financial difficulties.
